findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-preference screenshot is pixel-identical to the light view; the probe reports body background rgb(255,255,255) and color-scheme: normal while the dark media query matches.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and retint surfaces and text through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), retaining sufficient contrast.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt and provide no directional continuity.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations, and all navigation uses full-document links with no cross-document view transition rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and restrained transition styling, disabled or reduced under prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no scroll-aware orientation or return affordance.
findings.evidence: The homepage is 5,829 CSS px tall on mobile, while the platform probe found no sticky/fixed elements or scroll-state UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a lightweight sticky or scroll-state-aware header/back-to-top affordance that appears only when useful.

findings.summary: Repeated cards adapt only through the global Bootstrap grid, not their own container.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules; the card list is reused across listing and related-video contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card groups a containment context and use size container queries for card layout and typography, with existing media rules as fallback.

findings.summary: The mobile menu control lacks a visible keyboard focus indicator and is smaller than the recommended target.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe measured the 40x40 hamburger with outline style none; the control is below a 44x44 touch target.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and make the interactive hit area at least 44x44 CSS px.

findings.summary: Invalid routes silently become the homepage, leaving users without an error or recovery explanation.
findings.evidence: Navigating to a unique nonexistent route ended at the homepage URL and rendered the normal listing, with no 404 heading or message.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status and a concise not-found page with search, home, and category recovery links.

findings.summary: A parser-blocking framework script and stylesheet sit on the critical path.
findings.evidence: HAR identifies Bootstrap CSS as VeryHigh parser-blocking and bootstrap.min.js as a High-priority parser-inserted script; DOM confirms the head script has neither async nor defer.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer the script, extract minimal critical CSS, and load the remaining stylesheet without extending the critical chain.

findings.summary: Nearly all shipped Bootstrap CSS is unused on the homepage.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 25 KiB wasted from bootstrap.min.css, 94.98% of the stylesheet.
findings.suggestedFix: Build a reduced stylesheet containing only used components or purge unused selectors in production.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks a main landmark and top-level heading, and the menu trigger has no visible focus ring.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags no main landmark; DOM contains H2 headings but no H1, and the keyboard probe shows outline none on the hamburger.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main, add one descriptive H1, preserve logical heading order, and style all controls with :focus-visible.

findings.summary: The core video has no captions or equivalent text track.
findings.evidence: The representative detail page contains a video with controls but zero track elements; the visible keyword paragraph is not a synchronized caption alternative.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide accurate WebVTT captions with <track kind="captions"> and a transcript where practical.

findings.summary: Current-page pagination is implemented as a JavaScript pseudo-link.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found the “1” pagination anchor uses href="javascript:;", so it is not a crawlable navigation target.
findings.suggestedFix: Render current page state as text or aria-current, and give every navigable page a real URL.

findings.summary: Video pages omit VideoObject structured data.
findings.evidence: The detail page has Open Graph video tags but zero JSON-LD blocks despite representing a video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, thumbnail, duration, upload date, content URL, and description.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but baseline security headers and secure cookie flags are absent.
findings.evidence: The header probe reports missing CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy. The sole first-party cookie is not Secure, SameSite=None, non-HttpOnly, and lasts 399 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP in report-only then enforcement mode, add HSTS/nosniff/frame-ancestors/referrer/permissions policies, and make the cookie Secure with an appropriate SameSite and shorter lifetime.

findings.summary: A third-party advertising script receives an unusually broad browser fingerprint without visible consent.
findings.evidence: The platform/network evidence shows driverhugoverblown.com requests carrying plugin names, canvas/WebGL, screen, language, hardware, and timing signals; four third-party origins load on entry.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fingerprinting integration or gate a vetted, data-minimised provider behind informed consent; constrain it with CSP and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced isolation, clickjacking, referrer, and permissions defenses are not configured.
findings.evidence: No CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS, or nosniff header was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a narrowly scoped CSP with frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies, HSTS, and nosniff; consider Trusted Types after CSP is stable.

findings.summary: HTTP failure states are masked rather than handled intentionally.
findings.evidence: The nonexistent-route test redirects to a successful homepage with no not-found state, status context, retry, or recovery explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve accurate HTTP status codes and show explicit, actionable 404 and network-failure states.

findings.summary: Mixed-language content is declared globally as English with no per-language annotations.
findings.evidence: The homepage contains Telugu and Hindi text, but html lang is en and the probe found no hreflang; content snippets have no language attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark Telugu/Hindi runs with correct lang attributes, declare the primary page language accurately, and add hreflang only where true localized alternatives exist.

findings.summary: All thumbnails use legacy formats and most below-fold images load eagerly.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 17/17 legacy JPG/PNG images, 16 without srcset, and 13 below-fold images without loading="lazy" on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, add srcset/sizes, and lazy-load below-fold thumbnails while keeping the first likely LCP image eager with fetch priority.

findings.summary: Background third-party measurement runs on every page without task value.
findings.evidence: The HAR and platform probe show an advertising/fingerprinting script plus beacon activity on load, including on static listing pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary collection and defer any essential analytics until consent and idle time; batch events and stop work when hidden.

findings.summary: Related thumbnails and third-party scripts are loaded before users approach them.
findings.evidence: The detail image audit found all 17 images below the fold and none lazy-loaded; third-party scripts account for the largest individual script transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load related media, defer nonessential third parties, and set an explicit per-template third-party and image budget.
